question: Which engineering topics are rising on public GitHub, and can a simple model forecast next-day star activity better than a seasonal naive baseline?
unit: one topic on one UTC day
train_test: ≈6 months of daily facts; time-ordered split = first ~5 months train, last 30 days (1 month) test; test predictions scored against real held-out stars; never used to pick hyperparameters after the fact in v1
baseline: same weekday last week (seasonal naive) on stars
model: scikit-learn GradientBoostingRegressor on log1p(stars) with lag/rolling features; per-topic models for high-volume topics; hybrid selector keeps model or naive per topic by holdout MAE
metric: MAE, MAPE, RMSE on held-out stars (global + per-topic + hybrid) vs seasonal naive; day-level actuals vs predictions in data/test_predictions.csv; rising list = rank by week-over-week growth of 7-day star average

sources.lake: GH Archive hourly JSON.gz into MinIO (multi-day, skip-existing resume)

scheduler: docker compose profile schedule runs daily ClickHouse incremental backfill + retrain
